specDesc: Masters front-end and back-end systems. Highly adaptable. Excels in building scalable, robust web applications quickly.
coreSkillDesc: Known for her piercing debug-gaze and perfectionist eyes. A polyglot master of all arcane languages — from Node.js runes to Python scrolls. Her obsidian keyboard, etched with the sigils of a thousand deploys, strikes silence into broken systems before her will alone bends architecture to perfection.
